title: aria intermedia
intro: Aria intermedia, commonly known as Sweet Cicely, is a perennial herb native to Europe and Asia, belonging to the Umbelliferae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, such as bloating, gas, and indigestion, due to its anti-inflammatory and carminative properties. The therapeutic actions of Aria intermedia are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve flatulence, and alleviate symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). Its bioactive constituents include furanocoumarins, sesquiterpene lactones, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
